terms.meaning: A quick test that asks the database whether it responds.

sections.name: File setup, GET
sections.title: Health check handler
sections.what: Pings the database and returns ok, or unhealthy with status 503 when the ping fails.
sections.why: Gives a simple yes or no on whether the app can reach its data.
sections.watch_out: The failure status is always 503, so the code that tries to tell configuration problems apart has no effect.

summary: Web address that reports whether the app's local database responds.
purpose: Lets someone or a monitor check that the app is up and its database is reachable.
why: Likely reason: a quick health signal is useful for monitoring.
how: Pings the database. If the ping works, it returns ok. If it fails, it returns 503 with unhealthy.
outputs: A status, mode, and database field in JSON.
risks: The status code expression has the same value in both branches, and the error value is never used. The result is always 503 on failure, so the code looks unfinished.
debug: A 503 means the database ping failed. Check the database configuration.
